overview: Ledgerly is a personal financial planning and execution system that records income and expenses, allocates money by budget percentage, reports across periods, tracks projects, business finances and debt, and exports backups.
features: Record income and expenses with categories, dates and notes
Dashboard with balance, income, expenses, net and budget progress
Percentage-based budget allocation validated against expected income
Daily, weekly, monthly and annual reports that reconcile with records
Spending alerts derived from real recorded data
Projects with funding targets, contributions and remaining funding
Separate business revenue, costs, profit and cash flow tracking
Debt tracking with payments that reduce balances
Export and restore of financial records
Responsive layout for desktop, tablet and mobile
